theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (g : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ), (∀ k, Measurable (g k)) → ∀ C : Set (Rn n), MeasurableSet C → volume C ≠ ∞ → (∀ x ∈ C, Tendsto (fun k => g k x) atTop (𝓝 0)) → ∀ δ : ℝ≥0∞, δ ≠ 0 → ∃ A : Set (Rn n), A ⊆ C ∧ IsClosed A ∧ volume (C \ A) < δ ∧ TendstoUniformlyOn g (fun _ => 0) atTop A
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
